premises.text: Livestock disease creates large economic and public-health risk that is detected too late
premises.evidence_span: there's a huge economic risk. Just one single virus in 2014 decimated the pig population

premises.text: A software platform combines historic and real-time clinical data with genomics into one standard view for animal health analytics
premises.evidence_span: we bring in historic and real-time data, and then we combine it into one standard format, and finally combine this clinical information with genomics data

premises.text: Customers pay an annual subscription for tools and data, with add-ons for collaborative custom projects
premises.evidence_span: we charge them an annual subscription fee to access our tools and data

premises.text: Go-to-market rides natural network effects between large livestock and pharmaceutical customer-vendor relationships
premises.evidence_span: We take advantage of a natural network effect from their customer-vendor relationships

value.text: Predict, prevent, and precisely manage animal disease for a safer, more sustainable food supply
value.evidence_span: predict, prevent, and precisely manage disease in animals to ensure a safer and more sustainable food supply

causal_links.evidence_span: $13 billion in losses can be prevented if we were able to catch them early on
provide a comprehensive view of animal health and disease
we're at some of the largest livestock and pharmaceutical companies in the world

notes: Three software pillars (diagnose, treat, pharma targets), resistance map, and gene-target demos folded as applications/feature cascade of one clinical-genomics platform (§4.1.2/§4.1.7). Precision husbandry treated as vision/roadmap framing, not a premise (§4.1.4). Citizen-science ask excluded as appeal.
